attrs.evidence: Kohli 2026 ('Nine Judges, Two Effective Votes', arXiv 2605.29800, submitted 28 May 2026) measures nine frontier models across three natural-language-inference datasets and reports the panel at roughly two independent votes' worth of information, quantified with Kish effective sample size against a Condorcet null. VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY this round rather than taken on the audit's word. It is a precedent for the METHOD and not a constant to transplant: this loop's panel is three models, not nine, on a task distribution that is not natural-language inference. UNMEASURED HERE. What the result licenses today is one negative: three concurring models is not three votes, and mosaic/evidence.json types such concurrence as `model_judgment`, which discharges plausibility and nothing else.
attrs.gap: No probe set exists. Running this needs known-answer items the three models have not seen, which is a real design problem and not a scheduling one.
attrs.prior_art: Kohli 2026 (arXiv 2605.29800). Estimator, probe set, ground-truth source, per-model accuracy and pairwise error correlation all belong in the measurement record when this is run.
attrs.statement: The loop's audit stage carries a per-round measured effective-independence estimate for its evaluator panel, reported as an instrument result rather than as a constant.
